terms.content:
1. Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account on {brand}, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, do not proceed with registration.

2. Description of Service
{brand} connects players with padel clubs, letting players browse courts and reserve free slots, and letting club owners manage their courts' availability and reservations.

3. Accounts and Responsibilities
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided during registration and for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Club owners are responsible for keeping their courts' opening hours and reservation records up to date.

4. Bookings and Cancellations
Reservations are confirmed instantly at the time of booking. Players can self-cancel up to 2 hours before a reservation's start time; cancellations inside that window go through the club directly. Reservations are non-refundable: {brand} does not process refunds for any reservation, regardless of who cancels it or the reason. Any dispute, incident, or issue related to a cancelled or unfulfilled reservation must be resolved directly with the club. By booking a reservation, you accept full responsibility for any inconvenience arising from its cancellation.

5. Payments
Some clubs require online prepayment to confirm a reservation; in that case, payment is processed through Mercado Pago at the time of booking. For clubs that do not require prepayment, payment is handled in person at the club.

6. Data Handling
Data you submit is stored to provide the service and is not shared with third parties except as required to operate the platform or comply with the law.

7. Limitation of Liability
The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. {brand} is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service.

8. Changes to These Terms
These terms are placeholder text pending legal review and may be replaced or updated at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

9. Contact
Questions about these terms can be directed to your {brand} club administrator, or to {brand} support for player accounts.

HelpView.title: Help
HelpView.description: A quick guide to getting the most out of {brand}.

browsing.title: Finding a club and court
browsing.body: Open Browse Courts to see clubs near you, pick a court, and check real-time availability for any day.

booking.title: Booking a slot and paying online
booking.body: Tap an open slot to book it. If the court is free to book, your reservation is confirmed instantly. If the club charges a reservation fee, the slot is held for a short time while you pay through Mercado Pago or bank transfer, whichever the club accepts. If you don't finish paying in time, the hold is released automatically and the slot becomes available again.

myReservations.title: Managing your reservations
myReservations.body: My Reservations lists your upcoming bookings, with the option to show past ones too. You can cancel an upcoming reservation from there if your plans change.

tournaments.title: Joining a tournament
tournaments.body: When a club opens a tournament for registration, Tournaments shows up in your navigation. Open it to see the available tournaments, pick your category, and register your team.

profile.title: Your player profile
profile.body: Your padel category, preferred side, and dominant hand are set when you onboard. You can update your preferred side and dominant hand anytime from the pencil icon next to your player style card on your Dashboard home.

playersDirectory.title: Finding other players
playersDirectory.body: Players lists everyone signed up so you can search for partners and see their category, preferred side, and dominant hand.

onboarding.title: Setting up your club
onboarding.body: You set your club's basics (name, contact info, legal and billing details) when you onboard as an owner. You can revisit and edit most of it later from Club Settings.

gate.title: Before you can accept bookings
gate.body: Two things are required before your dashboard unlocks: a confirmed Play Padel membership payment, and a way to get paid — connect Mercado Pago or add a bank transfer account. You're guided through both steps automatically right after you onboard.

courts.title: Managing courts and closures
courts.body: Courts is where you add and edit your club's courts (surface, walls, net, photos, pricing) and close individual courts for maintenance. To close the whole club — for a holiday, for example — use Closures inside Club Settings instead.

reservations.title: Managing reservations
reservations.body: Reservations shows a day-by-day grid of every court's bookings. Click a slot to see that reservation's details and manage it.

clubSettings.title: Club settings
clubSettings.body: Club Settings is organized into tabs: Basic Info, Hours, Closures, Mercado Pago, and Bank Transfer — everything about how your club runs and gets paid lives there.

tournaments.title: Running tournaments
tournaments.body: Tournaments lets you create a tournament, build groups, enter match scores, and manage knockout rounds once group play wraps up.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Account Settings, in the menu under your avatar, opens your account profile — email, password, and security — managed by Clerk.

language.title: Switching language
language.body: Use the flag toggle in the navbar to switch {brand} between Spanish and English. The same toggle is also available in the header before you sign in.
